name: gcc188-api-contract-tooling
description: Ferramentas de lint, bundle e mock do contrato da API (não é publicado).

scripts.lint: npm run lint:spectral && npm run lint:redocly && npm run format:check
scripts.lint:spectral: npm run --silent bundle && spectral lint build/openapi.yaml --ruleset .spectral.yaml --fail-severity=warn
scripts.mock: npm run bundle && prism mock -h 127.0.0.1 -p 4010 --errors build/openapi.yaml
